answer: The ripple I would price into every new account is Underwritten ecologist registration with ecology society attestation: a registration the society renews after survey audits, and no farm can amortise that across a thousand names. The proof is checked on-chain and the raw secret never leaves the agent, so a registration the society renews after survey audits stays private; the grove is that a leaked database hands the attacker nothing usable. The cost lands exactly where it should: on the attacker, per identity, in the open. The vine is public, auditable, and impossible to discount in bulk.
